name: Trade Report 21 Choice
definition: Provides details on the reported trade transactions.

New.name: New
New.definition: Indicates whether transaction is reported for the first time.

Error.name: Error
Error.definition: Indicates whether transaction was reported by mistake and need to be removed.

Correction.name: Correction
Correction.definition: Indicates that the report is correcting the erroneous data fields of a previously submitted position.

TradeUpdate.name: Trade Update
TradeUpdate.definition: Information on margin held as a part of a transaction.
